text: Patient presents with chest pain and shortness of breath for 2 days. History of hypertension and type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Started metformin 500 mg twice daily and lisinopril 10 mg once daily.
Chest x-ray shows consolidation in the right lower lobe, consistent with pneumonia.
HbA1c was 8.4%. Fasting glucose elevated. Advised to continue insulin 10 units at bedtime.
Complains of severe headache, nausea and blurred vision. No fever.
Pain radiating to the left arm. ECG and troponin ordered to rule out myocardial infarction.
Take amoxicillin 250 mg every 8 hours for 7 days. Paracetamol 1 g prn for fever.
Known COPD with wheezing and cough. Salbutamol 2 puffs as needed. Spirometry scheduled.
Abdominal pain localised to the stomach; ultrasound of the abdomen normal. Omeprazole 20 mg daily started for gastritis.
Elderly woman with fatigue, weight loss and polyuria. Creatinine and lipid profile pending. Suspect diabetes.
Patient reports tinnitus and a persistent hiccup. Prescribed ondansetron 4 mg twice daily.
Atorvastatin 40 mg at night for hyperlipidemia. Blood pressure 150/95; kidneys normal on CT scan.
